annotations.title: What is coming for a product

description: For one product: its stage, the release window with who stated it (the company, a company event, pre-release reports, or iDevice's own estimate), and the pre-release reports its Guide lists, each with its status (Confirmed, Reported, Expected or Our estimate), the track record of reporting like it with the group that record comes from, how many independent origins and outlets carried it, whether sources disagree, and the outlet and link it names. A detail that has already turned out right or wrong is not listed. The same rows as the Guide's own tab on idevice.com.
name: whats_coming
title: What is coming for a product
